description: ViVi Fork v6.0.6 brings enhanced 320 kbps audio streaming, low-bitrate prevention, optimized UI performance with zero log overhead, and centralized repository update tracking.

changelog.title: What's New
items: Enhanced 320 kbps JioSaavn matching engine with multi-artist and duration tolerance
Direct update tracking and changelog integration with daveans1/vivi-music
Optimized Coil image loader and stripped release log overhead for smooth 120Hz scrolling

changelog.title: Fixes & Improvements
items: Fixed low bitrate 52kbps audio fallbacks to guarantee high quality playback
Fixed standalone package identifier to prevent installation conflicts
